summary: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
briefing: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.

summary: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
briefing: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
summary: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
briefing: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
summary: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
briefing: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
summary: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
briefing: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared. Optimus is in production, and Tesla aims to get Cybercabs to customers by year-end.

title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
summary: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
briefing: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
summary: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
briefing: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.
